AdeptusMechanicus.BackstoryDef.title: architect
AdeptusMechanicus.BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] designed and constructed buildings. On [PAWN_possessive] forgeworld home, most of the technical aspects of architecture were handled by an AI. This enabled [PAWN_objective] to push the artistic limits of the craft, but also meant [PAWN_pronoun] never had to get [PAWN_possessive] hands dirty at building sites.

AdeptusMechanicus.BackstoryDef.title: Magos Biologis
AdeptusMechanicus.BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_pronoun] is a Magos Biologis, highly specialized in genetics, physiology and systemology.

AdeptusMechanicus.BackstoryDef.title: Explorator
AdeptusMechanicus.BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_pronoun] is a Magos Explorator, who travels with exploration fleets and rogue traders.
